floorPlans.introduction: Compare the complete apartment sheets for both towers, from one-bedroom homes to four-bedroom layouts. Each unedited page retains its floor and unit references, area tables, drawing, key plan and developer notices.
floorPlans.selectorLabel: Choose a Baystar tower and layout
floorPlans.note: Totals include balcony or terrace space, not plot area. Repeated types have different unit or floor groups; where one sheet prints two totals, both appear as a range. Tower 1 and Tower 2 layouts are separately sourced. The selected sheet controls the PDF download and physical page link. Small differences of 0.01 sq ft can arise from rounded components. Confirm the signed unit plan and current specifications with Emaar.
